errors.evidence: The description makes a comparative interpretation that the subcategories of "Virtual Characters" are larger than those of the other two main categories. This violates the prompt's instruction to avoid interpretation and comparisons. Furthermore, this claim is not clearly supported by the visual evidence, as some subcategories within "Real Characters" (e.g., Writers) appear larger than some within "Virtual Characters" (e.g., Teleplay Characters).

errors.text_span: The pie chart is divided into 13 slices, grouped into three primary categories: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters.
errors.evidence: The chart is a nested pie chart (or sunburst chart) with two levels, not a simple pie chart. It has an inner circle representing the three primary categories and an outer ring representing the 13 subcategories. The description fails to mention this hierarchical, two-level structure.
The 'Virtual Characters' category comprises five subcategories in the outer ring (Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, Game Characters), not six.
The description invents an 'unlabeled segment' within the 'Virtual Characters' category that does not exist in the figure. All five subcategories are labeled.
